To produce flextables for different objects in one go, you can do the following:

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)

md[[1]] %>%
  map(
    ~broom::tidy(.x) %>%
      flextable::flextable()
    )

Q: Multiple layers of drop down menus for EXCEL A:

The trick is using indirect function.

Here is the tutorial.

The basic steps are

  1. Create a reference table in Excel
  2. Name range of the 2nd layer menu items as the value of 1st layer menu item.
  3. Use =indirect(cell of the first layer menu) for the 2nd layer menu data validation source.

Q: Case expression returning Null values A:

Single quote denote string literals. The expression 'Month' is a string literal, not the column alias from the previous row. It can never be equal to anything other than another string with the same text.

You could use the same expression in the case branches:

CASE
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) = 1 THEN 'AEP'
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) = 2 THEN 'OEP'
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) = 3 THEN 'OEP'
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) = 4 THEN 'LockIn'
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) = 5 THEN 'LockIn'
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) = 6 THEN 'LockIn'
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) = 7 THEN 'LockIn'
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) = 8 THEN 'LockIn'
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) = 9 THEN 'LockIn'
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) = 10 THEN 'LockIn'
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) = 11 THEN 'LockIn'
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) = 12 THEN 'LockIn'
END AS Enrollment_Period

But this is a bit clunky. You can lose a lot of the robustness by replacing the series of = conditions with in conditions:

CASE
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) = 1 THEN 'AEP'
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) IN (2, 3) THEN 'OEP'
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) IN (4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12) THEN 'LockIn'
END AS Enrollment_Period

Or better yet, since you've covered all the options the month function can return, use an else branch:

CASE
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) = 1 THEN 'AEP'
    WHEN MONTH(cova_evnt_efcv_dt) IN (2, 3) THEN 'OEP'
    ELSE 'LockIn'
END AS Enrollment_Period
